Name: Stardew Moon Back To Valley
Author: fz0308
Description:
This mod replaces the default sounds of Stardew Valley  to Harvest Moon: Back To Nature sounds. It's using SAAT to be working, so install SAAT first before install Stardew Moon: Back To Valley.

Install steps:
1. Install SMAPI.
2. Download SAAT and Stardew Moon: Back To Valley and extract them to Mods folder.
3. Run the game using SMAPI.
4. Enjoy.

Notes: For Stardew Valley 1.6, official SAAT is no longer compatible. Download the unofficial version [url="https://forums.stardewvalley.net/attachments/saat-1-1-3-unofficial-1-p1xel8ted-zip.20198"]here[/url].
Thank you and happy playing.
